import type { MetadataRoute } from "next";
import { blogPosts } from "@/lib/blogData";

const baseUrl = "https://easyliquidation.co.uk";

export default function sitemap(): MetadataRoute.Sitemap {
  const staticRoutes = [
    "/",
    "/about-us",
    "/about-us/how-we-work",
    "/services",
    "/services/creditors-voluntary-liquidation",
    "/services/members-voluntary-liquidation",
    "/services/bounce-back-loans",
    "/calculator",
    "/faq",
    "/blog",
    "/contact",
    "/do-i-need-to-liquidate-my-company",
    "/what-are-the-benefits-of-a-cvl",
    "/what-happens-next",
    "/insolvency-practitioner",
    "/company-liquidation",
    "/company-insolvency",
    "/creditors-voluntary-liquidation",
    "/easy-liquidation",
  ];

  const staticEntries = staticRoutes.map((route) => ({
    url: `${baseUrl}${route}`,
    lastModified: new Date(),
  }));

  const blogEntries = blogPosts.map((post) => ({
    url: `${baseUrl}/blog/${post.slug}`,
    lastModified: new Date(),
  }));

  return [...staticEntries, ...blogEntries];
}
